description: alg RSA-OAEP is refused with UnsupportedAlgorithm; decided by ADR 0054 §1.1: the alg setter refuses RSA-OAEP, which uses SHA-1 and which polyjose does not implement (ADR 0022), before any set member is read; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
